general_information.Description: This course covers fundamental concepts to prepare for more advanced engineering mathematics courses such as regular caculus, linear algebra and discrete mathematics courses. Topics included: polynomial, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions, solving systems of linear equations, sequences, series, limits, derivatives and integrals.
general_information.StudentTasks: Students must attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination.

assessments.Grading Guide: guided by instructor in class, completed by student at home, submitted by deadline

assessments.Note: ~10% of questions is ABET a2-objective oriented

assessments.No Question: 5-20 (At least 4*n questions where n is the number of Chapters covered in the test.)
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Current chapter(s) Each Progess Test covers at least 01 Chapter and at most 04 Chapters, and overall they must cover all learned Chapters of the course.
assessments.Grading Guide: by instructor, and by suitable means (computer, paper, oral...)
assessments.Note: Instruction and shedules for Progress tests must be presented in the Course Implementation Plan approved by director of the campus. Progress test must be taken right after the last lectures of required material. Instructor has resposibility to review the test for students after graded.
